title: Start a research run and watch stage progression
description: A user can start a research run and see the run begin progressing through stages.

title: Trace a claim to its deterministic lineage
description: A user can open the evidence hub and inspect a claim’s lineage back to its supporting evidence.

steps.description: Verify the lineage DAG is displayed
Verify the root hypothesis and supporting nodes are visible

title: Create a new research investigation
description: A user can create a new research investigation from the research list and see it added to the list.

steps.description: Fill in a research question with a unique topic
Verify the new research run appears in the list

title: Pause and resume a research run
description: A user can pause a running research investigation and resume it afterward.

steps.description: Verify the run continues through the next stage
Verify the run remains in progress

title: Trace a claim from the evidence hub to its lineage view
description: This test verifies that a user can open a claim from the evidence hub and reach the lineage view for that claim.

steps.description: Open the lineage view for a claim
Verify the claim lineage view is displayed
Verify the evidence chain from claim to hypothesis is displayed

title: Inspect the deterministic evidence chain for a claim
description: This test verifies that a user can inspect the lineage DAG and see how a claim is supported by evidence back to the hypothesis.

steps.description: Open a node in the inspection drawer
Verify the inspection drawer displays node details
Verify the claim support path is displayed

title: Review claim support status in the evidence hub
description: A user can review evidence claims and confirm which claims are supported or unsupported.

steps.description: Verify claim support status is visible

title: Inspect live telemetry for a research run
description: A user can open the live telemetry view for a research run and inspect streaming events.

steps.description: Verify streaming research events are displayed
Verify telemetry details for the run are visible

title: Browse artifact catalog and verify integrity
description: This verifies that a user can browse artifacts, verify a file hash, and see the resulting integrity status.

steps.description: Filter the artifact catalog by file type
Verify an integrity status is displayed
Verify the artifact remains visible in the catalog

title: Open a research run for inspection
description: A user can open an existing research run from the research list and view its detail page.

steps.description: Verify the run detail view is displayed
Verify the investigation context is visible

title: Inspect metric progression for an experiment
description: A user can view an experiment’s metric progression and confirm the trend data is available.

steps.description: Verify a metric progression chart is displayed

title: Save updated timeout and tolerance settings
description: A user can change settings and save them successfully so the updated configuration is confirmed.

steps.description: Fill in the timeout field with a new valid value
Fill in the tolerance field with a new valid value
Verify a confirmation message is visible
Verify the updated configuration is displayed

title: Browse artifacts and verify integrity status
description: A user can open the artifact browser and confirm artifact integrity information is displayed.

steps.description: Verify SHA-256 checksum and integrity status are visible

title: Review the experiment catalog and open an experiment
description: A user can browse the experiment catalog and open a completed experiment for detail inspection.

steps.description: Verify the experiment detail view is displayed
Verify the experiment objective and specification are visible

title: Review a research report's structure and grounding
description: This test verifies that a user can open a generated report and review its executive summary, methodology, experiment matrix, and metrics tables.

steps.description: Verify the report detail view is displayed
Verify the executive summary, methodology, experiment matrix, and metrics tables are displayed

title: Switch between stdout and stderr logs
description: A user can inspect both stdout and stderr output for an experiment run.

steps.description: Switch to the stderr logs view
Verify execution log content is displayed
Verify both output channels are accessible

title: Preview artifact contents before download
description: This verifies that a user can open an artifact preview, inspect its contents, and access the download action.

steps.description: Verify the artifact content preview is displayed
Verify the artifact remains available in the catalog

title: Open a generated report for offline review
description: A user can open a report and review its research summary, methodology, and metrics.

steps.description: Verify the report detail view is displayed
Verify the methodology and metrics sections are visible

title: Inspect report citations and supporting evidence
description: A user can review citations in a report and confirm the report includes supporting evidence references.

steps.description: Verify evidence-backed report content is visible

title: Confirm intact artifact hash result
description: This verifies that a user can run a hash check and review the SHA-256 integrity result for a selected artifact.

steps.description: Verify the SHA-256 result is displayed
Verify the file integrity status is visible

title: Persist settings after reload
description: A user can save settings and later see the same values still present when returning to the page.

steps.description: Fill in the timeout field with a new valid value
Fill in the tolerance field with a new valid value
Verify the updated configuration values are displayed

title: Preview an artifact before reviewing it
description: A user can open an artifact preview and inspect its contents before taking further action.

steps.description: Verify the artifact preview is displayed
Verify the artifact contents are visible

title: Search within experiment execution logs
description: A user can filter or search experiment logs and see the matching output update.

steps.description: Enter a search term that matches log content
Verify the log list updates to matching entries
Verify non-matching log lines are hidden

title: Confirm a valid artifact integrity state
description: A user can identify an artifact whose checksum passes integrity validation and see it marked as valid.

steps.description: Verify at least one artifact is marked as valid
Verify integrity validation details are visible

title: Reset settings after edits
description: A user can discard unsaved changes and return to the last saved configuration.

steps.description: Fill in the timeout field with a new valid value
Fill in the tolerance field with a new valid value
Verify the current configuration values are displayed
Verify the edited values are no longer present

title: Compare two experiments and review the comparison summary
description: This test verifies that a user can select two experiments, run a comparison, and see the resulting parameter, metric, and reproducibility summary.

steps.description: Verify metric deltas and reproducibility assessment are displayed

title: Compare experiments with differing outcomes
description: This test verifies that a user can compare experiments with different results and identify which metrics improved or regressed.

steps.description: Verify metric improvement and regression indicators are displayed
Verify the comparison summary is displayed

title: Open command palette and jump to a page
description: This verifies that a user can open the command palette, search for a destination, and navigate to it from the keyboard.

steps.description: Open the command palette with the keyboard
Move to a result and select it
Verify the selected destination page is displayed

title: Search command palette results for a run or experiment
description: This verifies that the command palette can search across runs and experiments and show a matching result that can be opened.

steps.description: Open the command palette with the keyboard
Type a search query for a run or experiment
Verify the selected item page is displayed

title: Review current settings values
description: A user can open settings and see the current configuration values before making changes.

steps.description: Verify the current configuration values are displayed
Verify the settings controls are available

title: Download a report for offline review
description: This test verifies that a user can open a report and download it in a structured format for offline review.

steps.description: Download the report as Markdown or JSON
Verify the download action is available
Verify the report detail view remains available

title: Toggle theme appearance
description: This verifies that a user can switch between light and dark appearance modes from the interface.

steps.description: Verify the theme control remains available

title: Persist theme preference after reload
description: This verifies that a user's theme preference remains active after reloading the application.

steps.description: Verify the selected theme is still active
Verify the interface remains usable after reload

title: Keep validation visible for invalid settings values
description: A user sees validation feedback when attempting to enter unsupported configuration values, preventing an invalid save.

steps.description: Fill in the timeout field with an invalid value
Fill in the tolerance field with an invalid value
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the settings are not saved

title: Check a report for unsupported claims
description: This test verifies that a user can open a report and see unsupported claim warnings when the report is not fully grounded.

steps.description: Open a report that contains unsupported claims
Verify unsupported claim warnings are displayed
Verify the report content remains accessible

title: Handle an experiment with no matching log search results
description: A user can search experiment logs for text that has no matches and see an empty result state.

steps.description: Enter a search term that does not match any log entries
Verify an empty state for log search results is shown
Verify no log entries are displayed

title: Show artifact filter empty state
description: This verifies that artifact filtering can produce an empty catalog state when no files match the selected type.

steps.description: Filter the artifact catalog by a type with no matches
Verify an empty state message is visible

title: Close command palette without navigating
description: This verifies that a user can dismiss the command palette and remain on the current page.

steps.description: Open the command palette with the keyboard
Verify the command palette is closed
Verify the current page remains displayed

title: Show empty state when configuration is unavailable
description: A user sees an empty or unavailable state if no configuration values can be displayed on the settings page.

steps.description: Verify an empty state or unavailable message is visible
